# Lossless fluid KRAKEN reference artifacts

Generated by Acoustics Toolbox v2023.5, commit
`475108519289c6fb488b58980c644ea14eccc604`, not by Rust. The pinned
`tools/reference/Dockerfile` uses Linux x86-64, GNU Fortran 12.2.0
(Debian 12.2.0-14+deb12u1), and
`-O1 -ffast-math -funroll-all-loops -fomit-frame-pointer -std=gnu`.

| Case | Coverage | Modes / pressure samples |
|---|---|---:|
| Pekeris | 50 Hz / 100 m, NG=1000 | 3 / 9 |
| PekerisFiltered | spectral selection, FIELD mode limit=1, interpolated source depths, tilted receiver array | 2 / 18 |
| PekerisDense | 75 Hz / 120 m, alternate material, NG=4000, surface/interface and zero range | 7 / 30 |
| PekerisRefined | NG=100, RMax=1000 km, forces three mesh levels (1/2/4) | 3 / 9 |
| MunkLossless | derived from upstream `tests/Munk/MunkK.env`, nonuniform `N` profile, automatic mesh and subtabulated vectors | 102 / 50 |
| SductTrapped | derived from upstream `tests/sduct/sductK.env`, nonuniform `C` profile, NG=8000 | 194 / 25 |

The Munk-derived input replaces `NVW` with `NVN`, bottom loss `0.8` with `0`,
and limits receiver/mode/field grids. The sduct-derived input replaces `CVW`
with `CVN`, restricts cHigh from 100000 m/s to the 1523.9 m/s bottom speed,
and limits the coordinate grids. These are **not** comparisons to the unmodified
official examples: those still need attenuation or leaky-mode support.
`tests/PekerisRD` upstream is a BELLHOP case, not a KRAKEN oracle.

Re-run fresh numerical comparisons from the repository root:

```sh
for case in Pekeris PekerisFiltered PekerisDense PekerisRefined MunkLossless SductTrapped; do
  tools/reference/compare-kraken.sh "crates/kraken/tests/fixtures/$case.env"
done
```

Fresh files go to `target/reference/$case-kraken/`. To update a golden, review
numerical changes first, copy its `.mod/.shd/.prt` here, trim trailing whitespace
from `.prt` lines, and update hashes below. Binary files are unmodified; `.prt`
CPU timings are nondeterministic, so the test reads only its modal table.
The test-only reader is `../../differential_reference.rs`.

One comparator runs on committed files without Docker and fresh Fortran files
in CI. It checks counts, coordinates, frequency, printed and binary wavenumbers,
attenuation, phase/group speeds, unit-phase-aligned shapes **without amplitude
rescaling**, and every complex pressure. Tolerances: printed k `5e-10`,
shapes `1e-6`, pressure `2e-6`, group speed `0.005` (two decimal print digits).
The rounded complex32 binary wavenumbers must match exactly.

Measured maximum errors (pinned Linux x86-64 GNU Fortran 12.2, Rust release):

| Case | k (m^-1) | shape | complex pressure |
|---|---:|---:|---:|
| Pekeris | 2.21e-11 | 0 | 3.1e-8 |
| PekerisFiltered | 1.98e-11 | 0 | 1.1e-8 |
| PekerisDense | 4.17e-11 | 5.3e-8 | 1.4e-7 |
| PekerisRefined | 2.21e-11 | 0 | 4.2e-9 |
| MunkLossless | 4.81e-11 | 1.9e-9 | 9.4e-9 |
| SductTrapped | 4.65e-11 | 3.8e-9 | 1.0e-9 |
